short_notes:
‣ Grok 4.20 Public Beta Release!
‣ New Aspect Ratio settings for Image and Video Generation!
‣ Numerous other bug fixes and improvements
long_notes:
Hey everyone! Back with another update today!

So a few days ago xAI officially unveiled the API public beta versions of Grok 4.20, and they are awesome! This update adds them as usable models in chats. Note that the experimental early-access Grok 4.20 models are still functioning as of the date of this update, so I have not yet found a need to remove them, and you can still request access to them in the Settings menu.

Additionally, when you are generating images and videos, you can now choose a custom aspect ratio from 14 different options with image generation and 8 different options with video generations!

This update also changes minor chat data details that may have negative effects on chats created before January 20, 2026.

I have also released a new Grok Voice shortcut that uses xAI’s new beta Text-to-Speech API for easy conversions with any of the five Grok voices, Eve, Ara, Sal, Rex, and Leo! Check it out at https://routinehub.co/shortcut/25060.

I hope you all enjoy this update!
